bit string types.name: source port
bit string types.description: source port, optional; indicates port of sending process; zero if not used.

bit string types.name: destination port
bit string types.description: destination port, meaning within context of a particular internet destination address.

bit string types.name: length
bit string types.description: length in octets of user datagram including header and data; minimum value is eight.

bit string types.name: checksum
bit string types.description: 16-bit one's complement of one's complement sum of pseudo header, udp header, and data, padded with zero octets to make a multiple of two octets.

fields.name: source port
fields.description: optional; indicates port of sending process; zero if not used.

fields.name: destination port
fields.description: meaning within context of a particular internet destination address.

fields.name: length
fields.description: length in octets of user datagram including header and data; minimum value is eight.

fields.name: checksum
fields.description: 16-bit one's complement checksum; zero transmitted means no checksum generated.

bit string types.name: protocol
bit string types.description: protocol field from ip header; for udp, value is 17.

fields.name: protocol
fields.description: protocol field from ip header; for udp, value is 17.

parsing context.name: ip header
parsing context.description: source address, destination address, and protocol field are obtained from the ip header.

helper functions.name: compute checksum
helper functions.description: computes 16-bit one's complement of one's complement sum of pseudo header, udp header, and data, padded with zero octets to make a multiple of two octets. if computed checksum is zero, transmitted as all ones; all zero transmitted means no checksum generated.
